Contract number: [complete] Contract conditions of December 2015

The Commission must be notified in writing of the exact date of delivery within the period indicated in Article I.3. All deliveries must be made at the agreed place of delivery during the hours indicated in Article I.3.

II.4.4 The contractor is responsible for the personnel who perform the contract and exercises its authority over its personnel without interference by the contracting authority. The contractor must inform its personnel that: (a) they may not accept any direct instructions from the contracting authority; and (b) their participation in providing the supplies does not result in any employment or contractual relationship with the contracting authority.
